items:
The Tipsy Pelican – Sleeps 22 | 6 person Golf Cart | 7 Bicycles | Putting Green | Walk to Beach

Welcome to The Tipsy Pelican, a vibrant and spacious beach retreat in the heart of Santa Rosa Beach along scenic 30A. Designed for large groups and unforgettable gatherings, this luxury home offers the perfect blend of comfort, fun, and convenience—with room for 22 guests, premium amenities, and a prime location just minutes from the Gulf.

Sleeps 22 in Comfort & Privacy

This home boasts 7 bedrooms and 7.5 bathrooms, with each bedroom featuring its own private en-suite bath—no sharing required. Whether you’re traveling with multiple families, a group of friends, or hosting a special occasion, The Tipsy Pelican’s layout ensures everyone has space to spread out and unwind. Bedrooms include a mix of king suites, bunk rooms, and cozy guest rooms—all equipped with smart TVs and fresh, stylish decor.
Bonus Third-Floor Game & Entertainment Room

BEDROOM CONFIGURATION:
Bedroom 1 - First Floor, King Size Bed, En-suite
Bedroom 2- Second Floor, King Size Bed, En-suite
Bedroom 3- Second Floor, King Size Bed, En-suite
Bedroom 4- Second Floor, King Size Bed, En-suite
Bedroom 5- Second Floor, King Size Bed, En-suite
Bedroom 6- Second Floor, 2 Full Size Beds, En-suite
Bedroom 7- Second Floor, 4 Full Size Beds (Two sets of bunk beds) , En-suite

On the third story, you’ll find a spacious bonus room designed for fun and relaxation. This entertainment hub features a collection of classic board games, an arcade machine, and even a karaoke stage—perfect for evening competitions or rainy-day fun. It’s a favorite hangout space for both kids and adults.
Free 6-Seater Golf Cart Included

Included with your stay is a street-legal 6-seater golf cart, making beach runs, shopping trips, and dinner outings effortless and fun. Park with ease, carry your gear, and explore 30A like a local.
Private Putting Green and Outdoor Fun

You don’t have to leave home to have a good time. The backyard features a private putting green, outdoor games, and plenty of lounge seating. Grill up some burgers on the gas BBQ, enjoy drinks at sunset, or challenge your crew to a little friendly competition.
Chef-Ready Kitchen and Dining

Cooking for a crowd? The Tipsy Pelican’s delivers. Enjoy a fully stocked kitchen with double refrigerators, high-end appliances, ample cookware, and a large island that makes meal prep a breeze. Gather at the oversized dining table or opt for outdoor dining under the stars.
Prime Location

Situated in a quiet, family-friendly neighborhood, The Tipsy Pelican’s is just a 5-minute golf cart ride or 10-minute walk to the beach. You’re perfectly positioned near local restaurants, shops, and 30A attractions like Seaside, Blue Mountain Beach, and Grayton. Whether you want to lounge by the shore or explore local gems, everything is within reach.
Amenities at a Glance
